rule: The canonical v0.11.1 historical release is restored and reconciled. Six v1 MUST clusters remain. A successor may be implemented only after an objective gap has a mechanically valid preregistration/freeze whose executable inputs, expected outcomes, acceptance criteria and failure policy are immutably bound and then reconciled by Lane 5.

objective_v1_must_blockers.observed_gap: Sealed evidence covers substantial MUST-02 through MUST-06 behavior, including deterministic discovery, traceability, task compilation, prompt/context compilation and execution resume. The complete MUST-01 representative end-to-end real-project lifecycle claim is not yet proven.
completion_evidence: claim-by-claim mapping from v1 MUST-01..06 to exact evidence

objective_v1_must_blockers.observed_gap: Existing impact/provenance evidence is narrower than MUST-07. Two frozen preregistration attempts have been rejected for implementation authority. Freeze 001 did not immutably bind executable inputs and complete acceptance semantics. Freeze 002 added fixture bindings but five of six negative controls remained byte-identical and therefore did not exercise their declared safe-reuse mutation behaviors; additionally the canonical validator recorded but did not verify the executable fixture digest.
objective_v1_must_blockers.v1_capability_advanced: MUST-07 and MUST-08 change propagation, determinism and provenance
objective_v1_must_blockers.expected_information_value: Highest currently bounded gap: freshness errors can invalidate otherwise-correct automation and downstream evidence.
completion_evidence: new retry identity distinct from failed freezes 001/002
immutable executable mutation fixtures with exact per-case before/after identities and provenance edges
genuine mutated negative controls for all safe-reuse behaviors except explicit byte-identity
mechanically verified executable fixture SHA-256 binding
determinism/provenance evidence mapped to exact v1 claims

convergence_review.question: What specifically prevents v1.00 right now?
convergence_review.answer: Six MUST clusters remain. The selected freshness gap still lacks a mechanically valid frozen experiment: retry 002 failed because most negative controls never mutated and its executable fixture digest was not mechanically enforced. A new governed retry is required before implementation can begin. PR #24 strengthens integrity evidence but does not close MUST-11 or alter this selected gap.
